description: STUB. Unlucky circumstances of birth, completing 'You were born #name#, ...' (Bad openers).
inauspiciousBeginning: raised in a shack behind an abbatoir
during a thunderstorm, feet first, in a coaching inn
under a waning moon, hirsuite, to the dismay of the attending physician
in a debtors' prison, owing money already
in a drainage ditch, and left there exposed
in a garbage heap behind a workhouse
in an offal-reeking scullery, under a halo of flies
